title: Light duty shelving only
text:
Light duty shelving only. These shelving units install reasonably well to studs, which is the one option I currently have for them. They are made of semi-heavy plastic and hold up ok to light to medium loads. For getting junk off the work bench and out of the way, these are a nice option. That said, they have limited functionality because of their somewhat small size.

Because these shelves are narrow, they will not adequately hold something like a regular-sized plant mister, or a paint can. A smaller mister or a regular spray can will fit with little effort. To be sure, these shelves provide a very nice solution for getting small containers of liquids off the bench and out of the way without creating a crammed, chaotic catch-all system where there are multiple layers to pick through.

These shelves are heavy plastic so they will hold up under moderate load. That said, I would not trust them to hold a full row of liquid containers reliably, especially if they are installed in a warm environment - plastic tends to warp and break down when in that kind of setting so keep this in mind.

The shelf with the compartments is ideal for in a small workshop - nails, screws, clips, small light bulbs, etc. can be served up easily without needing more jars. The flat shelf is good for cans and jars and bottles, and the slotted shelf is excellent for the likes of screwdrivers, punches and similarly shaped tools.

These shelves are handy for light organization but lack the depth to hold anything larger than a spray can. For a modest shop in need of some organization these will server well, but for more serious tools shops and garages these are not large enough or sturdy enough to be useful.

These versatile shelves can be easily installed in between open studs (16-inches on center), on pegboard or a flat wall surface. VersaShelf is made of durable chemical and weather resistant plastic. This is a simple and affordable way to organize and clean up your work area. Includes 3 shelves. Standard flat, tool holder, and four pocket.
